home.title: Incwadi yakho yesitudiyo

welcome.heading: Siyakwamukela ku-Glazecalc
welcome.text: Incwadi yakho isilungile. Isinyathelo sokuqala esihle: bhala i-glaze osuvele uyixuba, okokwakha kwayo namanani, ubone i-unity formula yayo.
welcome.confirm: Qinisekisa i-imeyili yakho: sithumele isixhumanisi ku-{email}. Ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili kuyasidinga. <account>Ikhasi le-akhawunti</account> yakho lingasithumela futhi.
welcome.confirmText: Sithumele isixhumanisi ku-{email}. Sivule ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ikheli ngelakho: ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili kuyasidinga. <account>Ikhasi le-akhawunti</account> yakho lingasithumela futhi.

recipe.title: Amaresiphi
recipe.text: Yakha i-glaze ngokokwakha namanani, ubone i-unity formula yayo, bese uyilondoloza.

import.title: Namathisela amaresiphi
import.text: Namathisela amaresiphi avela kuwebhusayithi, kuspredishithi noma emanothini, uhlole okufundiwe, bese uzilondoloza.

blends.title: Ukuxuba kwama-test tile
blends.text: Xuba amaresiphi akho amabili, amathathu noma amane abe ama-test tile anezinombolo, nalokho okufanele ukukale ku-tile ngayinye.

material.title: Okokwakha
material.text: Engeza okokwakha okuluhlaza kwakho, ku-formula yamakhemikhali noma ekuhlaziyweni komphakeli.

additive.title: Izithasiselo nokokufaka umbala
additive.text: Gcina okokufaka umbala nokwenza i-glaze ingabonisi okwengeza ngaphezu kwe-glaze eyisisekelo.

firing.title: Amarekhodi okushisa
firing.text: Bhala izikhathi, amazinga okushisa nama-cone kukho konke ukushisa.

notes.title: Amanothi
notes.text: Gcina imiphumela yokuhlola nanoma yini enye okufanele ikhunjulwe.

advice.title: Iseluleko nge-glaze
advice.text: Amathiphu okuxuba, okufaka i-glaze nokushisa, neseluleko sakho.

guides.title: Imihlahlandlela
guides.text: Kusukela kulokho okuyi-glaze kuya ekuyishiseni, nokugcina wonke umuntu ephephile endleleni.

trash.title: Udoti
trash.text: Buyisela lokho okukhiphe ezinsukwini ezingu-30 ezedlule.

account.title: I-akhawunti nezilungiselelo
account.text: Izilungiselelo, iphasiwedi yakho, ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili, nokulanda konke okugcina lapha.

home.newHere: Usemusha kuma-unity formula? <advice>Ikhasi leseluleko</advice> lichaza izisekelo, futhi <about>ikhasi elimayelana nathi</about> lisho ukuthi i-Glazecalc isebenza kanjani.
